'''This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]]''' was the [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]] of [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]] before [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]. She had two children. One of them was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]]. The other was her [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|daughter]] who became the next Blood Monarch.
